A Platform for the African Trade Union Movement

The ALREI Workers' Training Center supports all actors who organize, represent, train, and defend workers across the continent.

Trade Union Leaders & Officials

Strengthen governance, strategic leadership, and advocacy within your organizations.

Organizers & Shop Stewards

Mobilize at the workplace, lead campaigns, and defend members' rights.

Youth & Women Trade Unionists

Promote gender equality, inclusion, and the emergence of new labour leaders.

Educators & Researchers

Access participatory methodologies and data for labour research.

Formal & Informal Economies

Support all workers (salaried, informal, digital platforms, non-standard employment).

Partner Organizations

Accredited institutions, affiliated unions, and partners committed to decent work.

About ALREI

Research and Education for Workers' Rights

The African Labour Research and Education Institute (ALREI) is a semi-autonomous institute of ITUC-Africa. It strengthens the African trade union movement through labour research, workers' education, evidence-based advocacy, and collaboration.

The ALREI Workers Training Center extends this mandate online by making practical training and labour knowledge accessible across countries, sectors, and languages.

Learn More About ALREI Contact the Institute

Why Train with ALREI?

Relevant Content

Programs address current issues in labour, economics, and development across Africa.

Practical Methods

Case studies, exercises, and projects connect learning directly to practical trade union work.

Peer-to-Peer Exchange

Learn alongside trade unionists from diverse countries, sectors, and organizing traditions.

Multilingual Participation

Trainings delivered in French, English, Portuguese, and Kiswahili depending on cohorts.
